nom: Good Molecules 5% Niacinamide Serum with Ectoin

avis.texte: This is one profuct I refuse to ever run out of. My skin appearance has improved drastically since beginning to use this serum. My skin texture is like glass, feels unbelievably smooth, and Dont eveb get me started on the glow!

Price point is great. Serum texture is great. I like the glass bottle. Unfortunately, this formula did not work for my skin. I broke out and my skin became irritated and sensitive. I think the concentration of niacinsmide, sadly, doesnt work for my skin.
Plz make a bigger bottle! I use it morning and night and i go through a bottle of this faster than all my other products!!

I have sensitive skin, the kind that starts breaking out everytime a product doesn't agree with it. I've never really had oily skin but it's very easily congested and I can be an obsessive picker so it's a battle. This serum has made my skin so Happy! I waa using byoma's clarifying serum, and it's good I'm not knocking it, but I'm on a tighter budget now and decided to give this one a chance because i also like and use good molecules products. Thanks to a budget inspired change I now have my new MVP in my skin care :)

I've always used a niacinamide on my face from the brand natrium and I took a chance on trying good molecules and considering the reviews I decided to try this product. I used at night and the next morning I woke up with acne so bad, i have never had it looking like this ever in my entire life, ive always had just 1-3 pimples on my face nothing crazy until this. I had new pimples and white heads all over my face even on my eyelids and places I never break out. My forehead, cheeks, chin, jawline, everywhere looks so bad I am not exaggerating. Absolutely terrible. I never write reviews but I had to write one about this product because this is so upsetting.

This product i cannot beging to express how lucky i am to have found it. My skin is very oily, i breakout easily, and im a pale girly which any blemishes turn bright red. Once i started using this product i noticed my blemishes disappearing, no more breakouts and the redness i had in my face demished so quickly. Ive been persistant with this product for 2 months and if theres a product i can recommend is this one ! Disclaimer, everyones skin is different. I have very sensitive skin but it worked for me.
This is my first time purchasing this one can't say too much yet but I am loving it so far.
it has helped my pores tremendously & I've only been using it for two weeks.

avis.titre: How was this not gone viral?
avis.texte: I have now tested my routine with and without this product, and i can declare this little bottle to be the miracle worker. Keeps my dry skin hydrated in the depths of winter and the little bumpies at bay. Love! Buying my third bottle.

I used this at a time where not much was working for my acne. I liked this serum but didnt see huge results. Turns out my main skin concern ended up being acne rosacea so that could've been the reason why. I used the whole bottle and it didn't irritate my enflamed skin so i think its pretty decent.
My skin has been loving this product my pores are visibly smaller and my skin is hydrated
I really wanted to like this serum but sadly my skin really wasn't a fan of it and it made me breakout in places i usually don't… So this product i wont be buying again < 3

avis.titre: Skin so Soft, Skin so Smooth, Pores so Invisible!
avis.texte: I have large pores on my nose, on my cheeks, and some even across my T-zone. Not super self-conscious about them but I am "hyper" aware of their existence. I use a standard bar cleanser and oil cleanse (when i wear makeup)—but still they are very obvious. Been using this for about 2 weeks and I can say I SEE the difference. Alongside a toner + mandelic acid serum, my skin has become so soft and my pores are LESS VISIBLE. Doesnt irrtate me. No redness. I use both in PM & AM (with sunscreen as recommended) 10/10 will order and recommend this to any large pore girlies.

avis.titre: Hydration Meets Clarity in a Bottle
avis.texte: The Good Molecules 5% Niacinamide Serum with Ectoin has become a staple in my skincare routine. Its lightweight, water-based texture absorbs quickly without any sticky residue, making it perfect for layering under other products. After consistent use, I've noticed a smoother skin texture, reduced redness, and a more even complexion. The addition of Ectoin provides an extra layer of hydration, keeping my skin balanced and calm. For those seeking a gentle yet effective serum, this is a great option.

I have oily, acne-prone skin, and the Good Molecules 5% Niacinamide Serum with Ectoin has been such a lifesaver. Most serums either feel too heavy or cause breakouts, but this one is super lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue. Since adding it to my routine, my skin feels more balanced—my oiliness is under control, my pores look smaller, and I've had fewer breakouts overall. I've also noticed my skin barrier feels stronger and less irritated, which I think is thanks to this product. It's gentle but effective, and I finally feel like my skin looks healthier and calmer. Definitely a must-have if you deal with excess oil or breakouts!
I use this everyday and my skin is refreshed, smooth and hydrated.

I'm acne prone + dehydrated combination skin. Very clog prone. I found 10% niacinamide to be irritating, I tried this out not realizing what an amazing combination 5% niacinamide is with ectoin & NAG. This helped my skin retain moisture + develop a skin of steel. I use a lot of active in my routine on rotation, as long as I keep this serum in my routine I won't have issues.
My pores a very stubborn but this prduct has been able to help minimize them nicely! They are atill very much large and noticeable but over the past month it has gotten way better!
I loooove what it's doing to my skin so far...the texture has improved 10-fold! It's really a huge pores nightmare and i love that for me lol

avis.titre: This has worked so well o
avis.texte: This has worked so well on my face. It just needs to be a bigger bottle. It is very good product

I use this daily. It feels like snail mucin and thats one of my favorite facial serums. I use it on my frown lines and let it dry. You can feel the tightness once it dries. I use this along with brightening soap and serum. These products are amazing!

avis.titre: Lightweight, hydrating, and great for oil control!
avis.texte: I've been using this serum daily and have noticed a visible improvement in my skin's texture and oil balance. It absorbs quickly without feeling greasy and works well under makeup. My combination-oily skin feels more hydrated and less prone to breakouts. I appreciate that it's gentle and doesn't cause any irritation or redness. Definitely a great addition to my skincare routine!
I found this Niacinamide to be more effective. My forehead lines, especially in the center of my forehead, are less visible/deep.

I have been using this 5% niacinamide serum for 3 weeks now, it has gotten rid of my closed comedones, skin texture, and (most) acne. This + the 10% benzoyl peroxide wash from panoxyl is an amazing duo for acne. The only thing is that if I use 4+ drops my face becomes sort of oily yet slightly glowy, usually my skin's dry. My skin is a lot more hydrated and slightly brighter—as far as hyperpigmentation/acne scars, I haven't noticed a difference with improvement. For reference: I have dry, acne prone, sensitive, uneven skintone type skin. If I see a difference in my acne scars, I will update!
I barely started usibg it and it takes time but uve been seeing improvemnets on my pores they've gotten smaller

I bought this serum a few days ago and I'm already noticing a difference on my skin. I have always struggled with acne and dry skin, and even on my best days, my skin has always had texture from closed comedones. I was considering the other niacinamide serum, but I was worried that the 10% would be too much for my dry skin. When I saw this serum had niacinamide at a lower percentage and also had ectoin to help with hydration, I decided to take the chance and purchase it. It has now been a few days since I bought it, and after using it once in the morning and once at night, three drops each time, I can hardly feel any texture on my face. I think my skin is now the smoothest it has ever been since I first started getting acne.

I have acne-prone skin and been on a hunt for a daily serum, and I'm pretty sure I've found it with this product. It's only been two weeks but my breakouts (shoutout to hormones) have subsided and not left discoloration.
Good molecules will always be my go to for good clean skincare. I love the way their products make my skin feel and I love even more how affordable they are.
Love this product, not too strong and gives me a nice glow :)

Everything from Good Molecules i have tried has been my go to in my routine!! The fact that they use very few ingredients focusing on pure ingredients is a super plus for me!! I look forward to all the new stuff coming!!!! The prices are unbelievable for such great skincare!! Thanks again Good Molecules 👍

avis.titre: I use this constantly…and LOVE IT
avis.texte: I used to use a 10% niacinamide for pore appearance and oil control, but I noticed that that level was too strong for me, and my face got pretty irritated. Combine that with the dry winter air, and I was looking for something that was hydrating but would help to even my skin out a little bit. When I saw the teasers for this I knew I had to try it out and my god it is wonderful. Every morning I rinse my face with water and then apply this while I'm still slightly damp. It absorbs easily, doesn't leave any kind of film, and makes my face feel nice and hydrated. Absolute 10/10, I'm on my third bottle and I'm gonna keep coming back as long as this is available! Bonus points: I use the HERO Cosmetics light mineral sunscreen every morning and when I use this niacinamide under it, it doesn't pill up at ALL. That was such a pain with the last serum I tried so just another reason to love this serum.

SO GOOD AND GENTLE ON MY SENSITIVE SKIN! I swapped it out this winter because my skin is dry from the cold. The regular niacinamide is too harsh for my skin during the winter, and this ratio is perfect! It helps maintain my complexion without leaving me feeling dry and stripped. idk what ectocin is, but my skin LOVES it. I'm sure yours will too

My skin is super sensitive to niacinamide it ALWAYS gets red and irritated after ONE application. I have been using this for over a month now am/pm and I love the results. My skin is glowing and looking well hydrated. I use this before the hyaluronic acid serum in my skincare routine. Very Happy :)
Very moisturizing. A little goes a long way so depending on how much you use your daily lotion would feel unneeded until later.
I felt like it made my skin oily , I normally use their regular niacinamide which i love . it would probably be good by itself with no moisturizer if you have oily skin
I have sensitive acne prone skin and so far my skin hasnt reacted to it. I havent used it long enough to see result but will come back in a month to update.
It really improves skin overall, the skin appears more compact, smoother, more refined, age sports practically disappear and enlarged pores are definitely gone. Pretty amazing.

This serum honestly surprised me. I noticed results within the first week of using it. I bought this to add as an extra hydration step in my winter skin care routine and I don't think I'll ever go back! This serum has extremely helped with my dry red irritated skin and also has helped in reducing any further break outs. I have hormonal acne around my mouth area and often have red scarring/dark spots from it along with dryness and this serum has been my life saver this winter when I get a flare up. My skin is baby soft, hydrated, and my skin looks overall more even toned. I will definitely be repurchasing this serum and incorporate more of the good molecules line into my skin care. The serum also goes on like butter. It's a smooth, light, fragrance free serum that soaks into the skin and leaves it feeling hydrated and plump it also did not sting at all which is a plus for me. It can be a little sticky (like barely tacky) but that's really with any serum, and my moisturizer glides right over it with no issue. The pictures I attached are results after 1week, 2 weeks, and a month after continous use twice a day (morning/night).
I Really love this product! I have really sensitive skin and I get no bad reactions and I have been using it every day. It's definitely worth getting!
I'm so happy they created this!!! My pores are large so I need niacinimide but I also have eczema so I need it to be hydrating too. This is THE SERUM!

I was using the original niacinamide serum and I liked it, but this new one with Ectoin, OMG my faceee. My skin was skinnin. Reduced even more my pores and my skin looked like glass. Got lots of compliments at my work because my skin looked flawless.

This is the absolute best niacinamide serum I've ever used!! It's not sticky, it doesn't leave a residue, it doesn't pill up. It gives my skin the added hydration it needs and I get all the benefits from niacinamide. This is the best formulation of a niacinamide serum yet! I 100% recommend this!!
I want to make another review as my first review i hit 2 stars instead of 4. Very gentle product on skin.
Leaves skin so bright and I notice a difference with my acne scars.
A great serum to use for brightening and smoothing everything out. I use great molecules a lot and this is one of my go to products.
I have never been able to use Niacinamide because 10% is too strong for my sensitive skin. Yes, it's only been 2 day of using it, but no irritation at all, and I truly see and feel a difference.
